_about: Sabre Constructions' brand kit for the BBL video engine. Look = the real site (Desktop/sabre-constructions-website): css/site.css + docs/design-system.md v7 (2026-09-08). Voice + facts = that repo's CLAUDE.md six rules and docs/client-facts.md. Those win over this file.
name: Sabre Constructions

colours._note: ⛔ Sabre red #EB2227 is 'the button and the review stars. Nothing else' (design-system.md): so primary is charcoal and red lives only in 'button'. Warm paper, never blue-white. No black slabs, red bands or red rules

font.heading: Medium
font._note: Figtree 400/500/600 only; headings medium, sentence case; 'nothing is bold-shouting' (design-system.md). The weight_map caps every heavy part at SemiBold

review._source: client-facts.md, 2026-09-05: never round to 5; recheck the count before any new ad

voice._about: Summary of the real site's docs; they win on conflict. ⚠ protect=person keeps text off faces, but houses aren't a detector class: check by eye that no text sits on the house that is the subject.
voice.personality: A builder since 1990 who does not need to shout: calm, established, looked after. (design-system.md)
voice.audience: A couple in Wynnum or Manly with kids, a mortgage and a 1950s-80s house on a good block, reading on a phone at night. Fears, in order: homeless for two years, the number moving, the builder disappearing, whether they're allowed. (design-system.md)
pillars: Nathan is your builder, on call, with you every step of the way (he takes on a handful of homes at a time)
The path: Nathan walks your house with you, we help you with the designers, then we build it
Same street. Same school. A whole new house. A family building a family's home
On the Bayside since 1990: they stay with you

we_are.we_are: Nathan, the same builder from the first walk-through to the keys
we_are.we_are_not: a company with a sales team and a hand-off
we_are.sounds_like: Same street. Same school. A whole new house.
we_are.not_like: Our expert team delivers your project end to end

we_are.sounds_like: Build your new family home. On the street you already love.
we_are.not_like: HUGE SAVINGS on your dream home!!

we_are.we_are: only facts in client-facts.md, reviews quoted word for word
we_are.we_are_not: the strong version of what a good builder might do

voice.ads: Hook = the family that loves the street but has outgrown the house; proof = Nathan, real builds, real reviews (4.5); the ask = 'Book your walk-through with Nathan' (the block check lives on the contact page only). Tone reference: the LJ Hooker front-lawn ad (copy-rules.md).
voice.headline_test: Sentence case, calm, about their home and their street. No shouting, no unconfirmed promise.

blocked.why: The Google rating is 4.5. Never round it to 5

blocked.pattern: fixed price|one point of contact|not your year|free site visit
blocked.why: Written as the strong version of a good builder; Sabre has never confirmed them
Number of homes built is never stated: do not estimate it

_avoid_styles_why: Every current thumbnail style uses chunky bubble words or stickers: 'a builder since 1990 who does not need to shout' (design-system.md). Sabre needs its own calm style added to the menu
